descriptions.text: Goblin Pass. It’s a tattoo! On your forearm! Now you’ll never get a good job! Note: Pass tattoos cannot be hidden unless you purchase a coverup sleeve. Will show through any armor you may wear. Removes automatic goblin hostility. Allows for free passage through goblin-controlled territory in the dungeon. Warning: holding a Goblin Pass will cause natural goblin enemies, such as fairy-class creatures, to deal 20% more damage against you. Still, it looks kinda badass.

beats.headline: Branded, not stored
beats.text: The seventh of Carl's boxes is a silver goblin box: five sticks of dynamite, a lighter, and a Goblin Pass. The pass takes the form of the goblin-shaped skull on the box's lid and, instead of adding itself to his inventory, flies at his left inner forearm. Through his leather jacket it burns like a brand. The brand appears on the outside of the jacket too, the pain quickly abates, and the jacket is otherwise undamaged.

beats.headline: He never wanted one
beats.text: Carl puts his hand on the symbol branded onto his jacket and an infobox pops up. A tattoo, on his forearm; now he will never get a good job. It cannot be hidden without a coverup sleeve and shows through any armour. It ends automatic goblin hostility and allows free passage through goblin territory, and fairy-class creatures will deal twenty percent more damage against him. Carl grumbles that the system didn't give him a choice. He has no tattoos and never really wanted one.

beats.headline: Shown to three goblins
beats.text: Down an abandoned alley that smells of machines, oil and pineapple, Carl tells Donut they are not killing the goblins if they don't have to. Three level two goblins come at them with pineapple sticks. He lifts his arm, shows the tattoo and claims free passage. Their dots turn from red to white and they lower their weapons. One asks where he got the mark. Before Carl can answer, Donut tells them he blew up one of their filthy tractors and smeared three of their friends all over the cobblestones.

beats.headline: Twenty percent harder
beats.text: The clurichauns are fairy-class mobs, and their description says so: twenty percent more damage against him, due to his goblin pass. Running, buzzed and laughing at nothing, Carl takes a slingshot rock off the head. His health bar drops further than it should, the damage enhanced by his stupid goblin tattoo.

beats.headline: Nearly a sleeve
beats.text: A Gold Apostate box slaps another tattoo onto Carl's left upper arm, his largest yet: a flaming ball of snakes, one head reaching down to curl round the spiderweb tattoo on his elbow. With this, the spiderweb and the goblin pass, he practically has a whole sleeve on his left arm.
